findings.message: $HOME/koan-root/tree/@job is no folder at its path. It is @1 (/work), whose directory is missing: koan repair moves it back.
@1 (/work) has no directory. koan repair makes an empty one, with empty notes: whatever notes and material it held are gone.
@2 (/work/api) has no directory. koan repair makes an empty one, with empty notes: whatever notes and material it held are gone.
